rationale: The assistant reached the correct conclusion matching the hidden truth: normal induction pan noise caused by the new budget stockpot, with the hob 'perfectly healthy' and no part or engineer needed. It used the customer's evidence accurately (no codes, no smell, heats fine, started with new pot) and set out sensible red flags ('loud cracking, smell burning plastic, see sparks... error code') for when it would be a fault. Weaknesses are minor: it never actually asked the expected first checks (other pans, lower power) and relied on the customer volunteering the pan link, the technical explanation is a little loose, and the generic tripping-electrics safety panel was not really relevant to this case, though harmless.
